messages:
zoe.design: quick thread 0min01010hey all 0— i've prototyped a slim preview row for function outputs in the Run Explorer. goal: reduce vertical noise while keeping essential structured info visible. figma: https://figma.redwood/s/slim-preview

jamie.devex: nice — curious about the copy on the toggle. are we using 'Preview' or 'Summary'?

zoe.design: current mock uses 'Preview' (visual), and the button toggles to 'Full output'. hover tooltip says 'Show full function output'.

owen.product: 'Preview' reads ok but could be ambiguous. users sometimes expect a replay/preview action. what about 'Compact view' / 'Expanded view'?

nora.a11y: accessibility quick wins: toggle must be a native button or role=button with keyboard handlers, have aria-expanded, and an aria-controls linking to the output region. visible label is important — icons alone are bad. also check color contrast on the chevron.

kai.eng: implementation note: we can compute collapsed state by measuring token count OR raw line breaks. i'd prefer (tokens > 180 || lines > 8) as a rule. also we'll keep streaming into the hidden node and update preview slice.

jamie.devex: can we put a small row of key/value pills in the preview? customers want to see status/error/latency without opening.

zoe.design: yep — mock shows pills after the function name: status:ok, duration: 32ms, trace: abc123. pills are low-contrast background with 12px font.

nora.a11y: pills need sufficient contrast and focus order. if pills are actionable (eg copy), make them buttons. otherwise ensure they are announced as text; use aria-label="status: ok" on each.

owen.product: microcopy for pills: use short keys, eg 'status', 'time', 'id'. full tooltip reveals longer text. also add an overflow menu (ellipsis) with actions: 'Copy summary', 'Copy JSON', 'Open inspector'.

kai.eng: menu will follow roving tabindex and aria-haspopup semantics. note: copying large JSON needs to be throttled for streaming runs.

zoe.design: UX question: where to anchor the pill row on mobile? collapsing everything vertically may hide them. thinking to always show one-line stacked pills under the name for narrow widths.

jamie.devex: also propose a header-level 'compact mode' toggle to hide pills across the history timeline — helps with long sessions.

nora.a11y: regarding announcements: avoid global aria-live spam. instead, update a small live region when a user expands a specific output: e.g., "Expanded output for function refine_query: status ok, 32ms". only update on explicit user action.

kai.eng: agree. implementation detail: we can populate the live region string from the pill values. keep it short (max ~80 chars).

zoe.design: copy decisions: final text will be 'Preview ▾' visually, aria-label="Show preview of tool output" when collapsed, and 'Show full output' when expanded. we'll test 'Preview' vs 'Summary' in research.

owen.product: can we add 'Copy summary' kebab option to quickly paste into a ticket? often customers share the summary rather than raw JSON.

jamie.devex: yes — make that first menu item and keyboard accessible. label it 'Copy summary (text)'.

nora.a11y: last a11y note: focus ring must be visible with 3:1 contrast against the background for the compact UI. and ensure toggle is reachable in tab order ahead of any tiny icon controls.

zoe.design: thanks all. i'll update the figma with: visible 'Preview' label + aria-label, pills in the preview row, ellipsis menu with copy actions, mobile stack behavior, and a sample live region string. i'll post a PR for the component tomorrow for review.

kai.eng: i'll add unit tests for the collapse heuristic and a small e2e for keyboard toggling.

owen.product: i'll run this by a couple of pilot customers.

jamie.devex: LGTM. small follow-up: consider saving the collapsed state per-run so users don't get surprise expansions when scrolling.

zoe.design: good call, will add sticky state per session. thanks! :sparkles:
